action: Microsoft says no customer update is needed. Check Azure Service Health for the notice, review Connect Health configuration and Entra audit and sign-in logs, and watch for targeted phishing, as Microsoft advises.
date_note: Date of Microsoft's notification to affected customers, as quoted by BleepingComputer (investigation concluded 20 November); the article is dated 21 November.
exec: Microsoft told affected organisations that someone had unauthorized read-only access to their tenant metadata through a Connect Health API flaw.
impact: Microsoft has not disclosed how many organizations were affected.
plain: Microsoft told customers that a flaw in a Microsoft Entra Connect Health API let someone read some of their tenant details. Microsoft says it deployed a fix and found no unauthorized configuration changes.
summary: BleepingComputer reports that Microsoft notified customers that unauthorized read-only access to tenant-level metadata had occurred through a flaw in the Entra Connect Health API. Microsoft told BleepingComputer it deployed a fix on 19 November and notified impacted customers via Azure Service Health. Its notice says no unauthorized configuration changes were identified. Microsoft has not disclosed how many organizations were affected. Ciberseguridad LATAM reports that Microsoft detected the flaw on 9 November 2026.
title: Microsoft says a flaw in the Entra Connect Health API gave unauthorized read-only access to tenant metadata

validation.note: BleepingComputer and Boannews (relaying CyberSecurityNews and Microsoft customer notice) each state the Connect Health API flaw, the 19 November fix and no configuration changes. Microsoft own advisory not read.

review.note: title, date 20 Nov, 19 Nov fix, read-only metadata, no config changes, undisclosed count, 9 Nov detection quote, advice against BleepingComputer and Ciberseguridad LATAM; possible-duplicate is a different Microsoft event

evidence.quote: Microsoft detectó el 9 de noviembre de 2026 una vulnerabilidad en la API de Microsoft Entra Connect Health
